title: Prepared STAC Browser materials manifest
description: The closed description of the tree a consumer build reads instead of cloning, patching and compiling upstream STAC Browser. It is framework-produced, not consumer-authored, which is exactly why it is validated: a builder image is an input like any other, and a malformed or tampered manifest must fail the build rather than steer it.

repository.description: The pinned upstream repository. https only: the pin is evidence, and an unauthenticated scheme cannot carry it.

commit.description: Full object name. An abbreviated one is ambiguous by construction.

patches.description: The small reviewed framework patch series, in apply order. Empty is legal and means unpatched upstream.

materialsPath.description: A materials-root-relative POSIX path in NFC. No leading slash, no drive letter, no backslash, no dot segment, no empty segment, no percent-encoding, no control character, no trailing slash. Normalization beyond NFC is refused rather than performed: a path that needs normalizing is a path whose author and reader disagree.
